verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents support for many LLM providers, configured as `provider/model` refs, and a `/model` chat command for switching models within a conversation. Community reports corroborate real-world use with Anthropic (via Claude CLI), OpenAI/Codex, Google subscriptions and local models. Per-agent setup is implied by isolated agents with their own auth and sessions. missing for 10: an explicit named provider list (OpenRouter is never mentioned), explicit documentation of per-agent model overrides, and in-depth detail on provider configuration.
